verdict.rationale: A framework's ecosystem, such as its playground, docs site or editor extension, could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no assistant inside Svelte itself. The Svelte MCP server and the subagent references support external third-party agents (e.g., Claude Code) writing Svelte code, which is an adjacent capability, not a built-in assistant users delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
